question: In which of the following months was the grand finale and prize distribution ceremony of the Defence Innovation Challenge for Excellence (DICE-2024) organised during Aero India 2025 in Bengaluru by the Marathwada Accelerator for Growth and Incubation Council (MAGIC)?
solution: The correct answer is __**Feb 2025 **__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The grand finale and prize distribution ceremony for the **Defence Innovation Challenge for Excellence (DICE-2024)** was organized during the prestigious **Aero India 2025** event in Bengaluru. • This event was hosted by the **Marathwada Accelerator for Growth and Incubation Council (MAGIC)**, which focuses on fostering innovation in the defence sector. • The event was held in the month of **February 2025**, aligning with the Aero India 2025 schedule, which is a biennial air show and aviation exhibition organized by the Indian Ministry of Defence. • The specific date for the grand finale was **Sat Feb 01 2025**, marking the beginning of the Aero India 2025 event. • The timing of this event is critical as Aero India is a significant platform that brings together innovators, defence personnel, and industry leaders to showcase technological advancements and discuss future opportunities in the defence sector.
